definition: `Opines x p`: x is now opining, judging or having it appear that p (Aristotle names opinion, false opinion and imagination together). `asOpinion p` is the respect in which an opiner of p is affected by opining it. Neither is defined in Lean; whether opining is a being moved in that respect is the separate premise STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION, not part of this definition.
